name: overnight_batch_tax_lane_lq1512_20261109
comment: overnight-batch-tax (LQ-20261107-1512): the lane's first n8n run reported rows_produced 0 not because
it produced nothing but because the cron twin had queued the same (symbol, request_type, tax_agent)
work nine seconds earlier and insert_agent_job_unless_pending dedups pending work by design.
Pins the lane's own boundary with a recording fake connection: every holding with an unrealized
loss worse than -500 and every SSDI-flagged proposal is queued when nothing is pending, pending
work is skipped, the holdings leg stops at ten, and the returned count equals the rows actually
inserted (never a constant). Mutation-checked: forcing the lane back to a constant 0 turns 7 of
these 10 red. Synthetic symbols only; no DB, no network. L345 is retired, so the lane is
single-run from its next slot. Its caller's reporting is LQ-20261107-1539, a separate file.
